question: For POST api/customer/{orderId}/updateStatus, what is saved before the response, when is eventLink populated, and which URL values are passed to the response constructor?

agents_working_file.start_sha256: not separately captured; read-only inspection throughout and unchanged status/length

answer.saved_before_response: The handler loads the owned order, sets order.StatusId to command.StatusId and order.Updated to DateTime.UtcNow, then awaits dbContext.SaveChangesAsync(cancellationToken). It constructs the response only afterward.
answer.eventLink_condition: eventLink starts null and is populated only when command.StatusId == 6 and both order.TourTimeSlotsId and order.TimeSlotDate have values. It is PublicAppBaseUrl with trailing slashes removed, followed by /customer/images/{timeslotId}/{date formatted yyyy-MM-dd}.
answer.homepage_link_resolution: ResolveHomepageLink returns Tour.HomepageUrl when nonblank; otherwise it returns PublicAppBaseUrl.TrimEnd('/') + /customer/collections, using https://app.taggable.com when PublicAppBaseUrl is blank.
